rows.role_title: President of the Indian National Congress
rows.text: In remarks headed 'Opening Remarks of Congress President Smt. Sonia Gandhi at CWC Meeting', 16 October 2021, she says 'I have been interim Congress President ever since the CWC, asked me to return in this capacity in 2019', that the deadline for electing a regular President by 30 June 2021 was extended indefinitely by the Working Committee on 10 May 2021, and that she is 'a full-time and hands on Congress President'.
